title: Advances Already Drawn Against the Payday — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Instant Transfer Share
content:
For an instant transfer to an external debit card on the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, the period-advance share multiplies the instant transfer amount by the transfers and fees already carrying the plan's next payday, net of their returns and reversals, as a share of the instant accrued net:

| Transfers and fees carrying the next payday, net, as a share of the instant accrued net | Share taken |
|---|---|
| more than 30 percent | 80 percent |
| any such amount with no instant accrued net | 80 percent |
| more than 10 up to 30 percent | 90 percent |
| 10 percent or less | in full |

The amount compared is the plan's transfers carrying the next payday less their returns, plus its fees carrying that date less their reversals.

## Hypothetical readings (instant accrued net 500.00 USD)

- Net transfers and fees of 50.00 USD are 10 percent: in full.
- Of 50.01 USD: just over 10 percent, 90 percent.
- Of 150.00 USD: 30 percent, 90 percent.
- Of 151.00 USD: above 30 percent, 80 percent.
- With no instant accrued net and 20.00 USD already drawn: 80 percent; with nothing drawn: in full.
